slots.jd.workflow-startup.about: Skylark builds workflow software for teams who are tired of chasing status updates across a dozen tools. As our Associate Product Manager, you'll own a clear slice of the product, talk with customers, dig into the data and ship alongside engineering and design. You'll have a senior PM in your corner, plenty of room to learn and real ownership from your first week.
slots.jd.workflow-startup.duties:
What you'll do
- Keep engineering, design, support and sales in sync on what's shipping and why
- Run regular metrics reviews and turn what you find into clear next steps
- Set up and lead customer interviews to understand how teams actually get work done
- Write crisp specs and user stories with your senior PM reviewing
- Track feature launches from kickoff to follow-up and share what we learned
- Help shape the backlog based on customer evidence and usage data
slots.jd.workflow-startup.needs:
What we're looking for
- 1 or more years of experience in product management, product operations or a closely related role
- Comfort with customer discovery and turning interview notes into product decisions
- Pricing analysis and go-to-market planning experience, even on a small scope
- Hands-on use of Tableau for dashboards and Figma for reviewing or sketching designs
- Clear written documentation habits in Confluence or a similar tool
slots.r1.b1: Coordinates feature launches through stakeholder alignment across product, design and support teams, cutting post-launch rework by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Writes requirements for fee and plan changes, grounding each decision in pricing analysis reviewed by a senior product manager.
slots.r1.b3: Runs metrics reviews using product analytics in Amplitude, flagging a drop-off step whose fix lifted task completion by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Conducts customer interviews and applies prioritization frameworks to rank the resulting requests for the team backlog.
slots.r1.i1: Supports roadmap planning at Bluebird Family Services, turning team input into a quarterly plan reviewed with a senior product manager.
slots.r1.i2: Contributes to vendor and pricing decisions at Bluebird Family Services by preparing analysis and options for senior product leads to review.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level product manager with about 1 year of experience owning small, well-defined pieces of product work under review by a senior colleague. Brings pricing analysis, requirements writing and Tableau reporting to day-to-day product decisions.
slots.summary.2: Associate product manager with about 1 year of experience at a family services organization, handling scoped tasks with a senior colleague reviewing the work. Skilled in requirements writing, pricing analysis and building dashboards in Tableau.
